label: Real Estate Agents
description: Audit framework for residential and commercial real estate professionals.
auditFocus: Lead response time and nurture sequences
voicePromptHints: Ask how quickly they respond to new online leads.
Ask how many follow-up touches they make before giving up on a lead.
Ask about their current CRM and whether it is automated.
Ask how they handle open house leads after the event.
Ask what their average days-on-market is versus the local average.
